import fitz  # PyMuPDF
import sys
import io
import os

# Handle encoding
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper\(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'\)

pdf_path = "30.Recources/AT/PDFs/Hatcher - 2002 - Algebraic topology.pdf"
doc = fitz.open\(pdf_path\)

# Extract images from pages 105-109
start_pdf_page = 105
end_pdf_page = 109

print\("Checking for images in pages 105-109..."\)

image_count = 0
image_info = []

for page_num in range\(start_pdf_page, end_pdf_page + 1\):
    page = doc[page_num]
    image_list = page.get_images\(full=True\)
    
    if image_list:
        print\(f"\\nPDF page {page_num} \(book page {page_num - 8}\): Found {len\(image_list\)} image\(s\)"\)
        
        for img_index, img in enumerate\(image_list\):
            xref = img[0]
            base_image = doc.extract_image\(xref\)
            image_bytes = base_image["image"]
            image_ext = base_image["ext"]
            
            # Save image with descriptive name
            book_page = page_num - 8
            image_name = f"Hatcher_p{book_page}_img{img_index + 1}.{image_ext}"
            image_path = f"{image_name}"
            
            with open\(image_path, "wb"\) as img_file:
                img_file.write\(image_bytes\)
            
            image_info.append\({
                'page': book_page,
                'pdf_page': page_num,
                'name': image_name,
                'index': img_index
            }\)
            image_count += 1
            print\(f"  Saved: {image_name}"\)

doc.close\(\)

if image_count == 0:
    print\("\\nNo images found in the specified page range."\)
else:
    print\(f"\\nTotal images extracted: {image_count}"\)
    print\("\\nImage list for markdown insertion:"\)
    for img in image_info:
        print\(f"  Book page {img['page']}: ![[{img['name']}]]"\)

PYTHON_EOF)
